credit: Computed at build time via the geocentric Lambert model (src/lib/lambert-geocentric.ts, ADR-085). Earth→Moon: 100% cells feasible (0 of 11200 below the parabolic floor). Full [3, 14 d] TOF band — low-branch Lambert to the ~5 d minimum-energy ceiling, high branch (α → 2π − α) for the slow/phasing transfers above it. ∆v = TLI (µ_Earth LEO departure) + LOI (patched-conic, µ_Moon). Moon ephemeris: src/lib/astronomy/moon.ts (Schlyter/Brown analytic). Representative two-body estimate — validated against Apollo TLI ~3.05–3.15 / LOI ~0.8–0.9 km/s.
